HEEWON STYLE — a KOREAN WEBTOON character-introduction splash PAINTED like a premium digital painting, dramatic manhwa cover and weekly-Jump color-spread (One Piece / Naruto manga energy). BOLD THICK tapered black ink, hatched manga shadows, painted jewel-tone color, loaded brush, dry-brush, paper grain, one hard key. THREE PLANES always: (1) a LARGE dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND object filling a third of the frame near the lens — creamy painted bokeh; (2) the beat RAZOR-SHARP in the midground; (3) the place DISSOLVING into atmospheric wash, haze, and round lamp bokeh. Shallow DOF. Overlapping shapes. Dramatic camera — dutch, worm’s-eye, over-shoulder, never a level two-shot. FACE LOCK: copy the attached sheet’s unique bones — Changjori is the LEAN long-oval face with small close-set eyes, a narrow nose, a thin sparse chin-goatee, two thin red antenna-feathers on a small black pointed cap (hair IRON-GRAY, ignore sheet black). Ulbul is sly narrow triangular eyes, clean-shaven, one long braid, straw satgat. Ummo is the older ROUND face with white topknot and thin white moustache-and-goatee. Jaemo is the square stern face, no beard, black peaked hat. Bongsang is the short black beard and gold openwork crown. NEVER a generic handsome extra. New verb pose. Composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop. NOT a flat catalogue. NOT every plane in equal focus. NOT cel cartoon. NOT photoreal. NOT 3D. No text. No speech bubbles. No watermark.
